upstream_provenance.source_context:
# Select capabilities before constructing native-backed objects

## Platform difference

Constructing an unsupported native-backed object can fail before a later platform branch has a chance to avoid using it.

## Implementation

Simple Live makes its non-OH CookieManager lazy and prevents accessors from constructing an uninitialized media_kit player on OH. KikoFlu centralizes capability predicates before desktop-window, MPV and FFI initialization. Neon implements a platform capability object, including disabled camera/push/window features. Kelivo disables selected settings/rendering features in its imported snapshot; these are implementation boundaries rather than proof of OS-wide absence. Kazumi retains a dynamic-color guard; PixEz adds OH to shared feature branches. NJU temporarily hides an import/export entry before later calendar work, so routes must be assessed at the selected revision.

## Applicability

Use capabilities tied to implemented backends and initialization requirements, rather than classifying every OH device as Android-like or every large screen as a desktop backend.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A true capability flag is an assertion to test. A false flag may be temporary. Do not present local policies such as skipped MediaKit initialization as a statement that no OH MediaKit implementation can exist.

## Verification

Construct controllers on OH without unavailable plugins, enter every advertised feature, and verify unavailable features fail explicitly before resource allocation.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
